worldcombat.skill.acupressure.summary: Temporarily raise one random stat on yourself or a nearby ally. The flow must end before another press; a quick press is faster, while a steady press grants one extra stage.
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.use.0: Prepare one random stat before a fight
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.use.1: Give a nearby ally a short boost
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.use.2: Use a steady press for two stages when there is time
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.descriptio: Press yourself or a friendly ally in reach: one random stat below +6 is raised by %1$s stage(s), up to +6. Each target carries only one Acupressure window at a time.
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.steady.on: Steady press: +2 stages, with 5 more windup ticks and cooldown ×1.25.
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.steady.off: Quick press: +1 stage, with a shorter windup and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.descriptio: Reach %1$s blocks; flow lasts about %2$s. This boost ends when the status expires or is cleared.
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.timing: Ally move (self or partner), range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.growth.0: At level %1$s the flow lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.growth.1: At level %1$s the flow reaches %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.acupressure.preference: On: steady press, +2 stages, 5 more windup ticks and cooldown ×1.25. Off: quick press, +1 stage, with a shorter windup and cooldown.
Consider pressing a partner within this distance; larger means wandering over to help.
A threat closer than this makes the companion respond instead of pressing itself; larger gives up setup more often up close.
